By downloading, installing, signing in to or continuing to use the App, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to these Terms, the Privacy Policy and the ValHub Community Guidelines. These documents form an integral part of the Terms.

## 4. Riot Account and sign-in data

You sign in through a web window that shows Riot Games' official sign-in page. ValHub does not receive, read or store the password you enter on that page. After you sign in, the sign-in data issued by Riot (the access token and cookies, i.e. files that help Riot remember you are signed in) is stored only in your operating system's secure storage on your device.

- You may add to the App only Riot Accounts that you own or that their owner has lawfully authorized you to use.
- You are responsible for keeping your device, password and two-factor authentication codes secure, and for all activity on your Riot Account.
- The "Saved sign-in details" feature is optional: if you choose to save your username and password, they stay only in secure storage on your device and are filled into Riot's sign-in page only when you ask. You should weigh the risk of saving passwords on a shared device, and you can delete this information at any time.
- Sign out of the App and change your Riot password immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your device or account.
- Your use of a Riot Account must always comply with Riot Games' Terms of Service and policies. Riot Games may restrict or ban your account under its own policies; we have no power to intervene in those decisions.

## 7. Actions on your Riot Account

Some features let you change the state of your Riot Account, for example: changing your loadout, joining or leaving a party, starting or cancelling matchmaking, or leaving a match.

- These actions are performed only when you yourself tap the corresponding button; the App never performs them automatically on your behalf.
- For actions that may lead to in-game penalties (for example leaving a match or dodging), the App shows a warning and asks you to confirm.
- You are solely responsible for the consequences of the actions you take, including penalties, loss of ranked points (RR), queue restrictions or other measures applied by Riot Games.

## 8. Community and User Content

### Riot ID verification

To use Community, the App verifies your Riot ID with Riot Games through ValHub's Community server, as described in the Privacy Policy. Your display name in Community is your verified Riot ID, together with your Player Card, rank and region.

### Responsibility for content

- You are responsible for all User Content you post and warrant that you have sufficient rights to that content (for example the right to use screenshots and images you upload).
- Your content must comply with the Community Guidelines and the law. Content that violates applicable law or that is insulting, harassing, hateful, pornographic, violent, fraudulent, spam, unauthorized advertising, account trading, boosting services or cheating software, as well as content that reveals other people's personal information, is strictly prohibited.
- LFG posts may contain a party code; anyone who sees the post can use that code to join your party until the post expires (30 minutes) or you turn off the code in the game.

### Rights you grant us

You remain the owner of your User Content. When you post, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide right. This right allows us to store, technically copy, reformat (for example compress or resize images) and display that content to other users in the App, solely for the purpose of operating Community. This right ends when the content is deleted from the system, except for backups that remain for a short time or where the law requires retention.

### Reporting and moderation

- You can report posts, comments or LFG posts that break the rules directly in the App. Content that receives enough reports from different users may be hidden automatically pending review.
- We have the right, but not the obligation, to review, hide or remove content, and to restrict or suspend Community access for anyone who violates the Terms or the Community Guidelines, with or without prior notice.
- We do not review all content in advance and are not responsible for User Content posted by others. The views expressed in that content belong to the person who posted it.
- We may provide information to competent public authorities upon lawful request.
